name: K4
title: Elecraft K4
summary: 100 W 160–6m direct-sampling SDR, 7in touch pan, main+sub RX on one ADC, Ethernet remote; upgradeable to K4D/K4HD.

f.band_scope: real-time panadapter + waterfall, per-RX hi-res mini-pan
f.roofing_filters: none (direct sampling); crystal filters only in K4HD KHDR4
special: wideband main+sub RX (any bands, shared ADC)
requires: external ATU or KAT4 option for non-resonant antennas

extra.usb_note: USB-B = two virtual COM ports + USB audio
extra.lan_note: 100% Ethernet remote from 2nd K4 (K4/0) or PC/tablet incl. panadapter data
extra.io: 3× USB-A, USB-B, RS232, Ethernet, video out, LINE in/out, ACC, 12 V out
extra.upgrade_path: K4→K4D (KRX4/KDIV4 kit); K4/10→100 W (KPA4); K4HD (KHDR4 dual superhet) 'coming soon'; VHF/UHF ~15 W module planned
extra.ant_note: KAT4 option adds ATU + 3 antenna jacks; up to 5 RX antenna sources (medium on base jack count)
extra.dual_watch_note: main+sub receivers share one ADC/BPF set and one antenna path ('wideband dual watch'); K4D adds 2nd ADC + BPF for independent antennas/diversity

gotchas: No internal ATU in base price — KAT4 is an extra option; ico-ic-7610-32 / kwd-ts-890s / ysu-ftdx-101d include one
Sub RX shares the main ADC/antenna — no diversity or independent-antenna SO2V until the K4D upgrade (ecr-k4d); ico-ic-7610-32 has two ADCs for ~$2k less
Options make it expensive: K4 + KAT4 + MH4 mic pushes well past $6.5k — approaching fri-flex-8600m territory, ~1.5× ico-ic-7610-32
Needs a separate 13.8 V ~25 A supply (4–23 A TX) and no mic in the box
HF+6m only today — the 2m/70cm module has been 'planned' for years; ico-ic-9700 for V/U
Direct sampling only: K4HD dual-superhet front end for extreme-signal (multi-op/Field Day) sites is still 'coming soon'
best_for: K3S/P3 owners moving up with familiar controls
knob-driven SDR shack with Ethernet remote

pairs.why: no internal PSU; up to 23 A TX
no mic included; required for SSB
2nd ADC + BPF set for diversity / independent antennas
same radio with diversity dual RX
